verdict.rationale: The docs show CodeRabbit connects through GitHub, GitLab and other Git-host accounts and is 'up and running in 2 minutes' (docs-16, docs-56). It delivers feedback 'within moments of opening a pull request', posting inline comments, walkthrough comments and one-click suggestions on PRs (docs-39, supp-4, docs-44, docs-43, docs-23). Community users confirm it reviews their GitHub PRs (comm-1, comm-6, comm-7). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the GitHub/GitLab app installation flow itself, and GitLab-specific evidence of native inline merge-request comments, since the inline-comment evidence is GitHub-centric.
